tagline: Better Care for a Better World
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin slightly up (+0.8 pts to 32.5%) driven by cost discipline and logistics network optimization under the Powering Care strategy.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on equipment and facilities to enhance the logistics chain and support supply chain transformation.
kpis.description: Capex related to supply chain transformation under the Powering Care strategy, including value stream simplification and scalable automation.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of sales.
kpis.description: Gross margin slightly up at 32.5% (vs 31.7% in 2024), driven by cost discipline and logistics network optimization.
kpis.signal: Improvement in industrial efficiency and cost discipline

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin at 14.2% (vs 13.7% in 2024), supported by productivity gains and process simplification. Operating profit of $2,351M on revenue of $16,447M.

kpis.name: R&D Investment as Percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of net sales.
kpis.description: R&D stable at 1.8% of revenue, focused on consumer-centric innovation in daily-use categories and patented proprietary technologies.
kpis.signal: Targeted innovation in hygiene products and consumer solutions

kpis.name: Total Headcount (thousands of employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees worldwide, expressed in thousands.
kpis.description: Headcount slightly down to 43K (vs 44K in 2024, -2%) following the 2024 Transformation Initiative (4-5% reductions expected) and the creation of the IFP joint venture with Suzano.
kpis.signal: Workforce optimization amid restructuring and transformation

kpis.name: Kenvue Acquisition Costs
kpis.explanation: Acquisition costs and direct expenses related to the strategic acquisition of Kenvue, Inc. announced in November 2025.
kpis.description: Acquisition costs of $32M incurred in 2025 for the acquisition of Kenvue, a global consumer health leader. Transaction announced on November 2, 2025, involving approximately 280M shares to be issued and $6.7B in cash consideration.
kpis.signal: Strategic preparation for a major transformation and consolidation of the consumer health portfolio

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Raw Material Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Raw material prices, particularly kraft pulp, recycled fiber, and petroleum-derived materials, experience significant fluctuations. Inability to pass through these increases to selling prices could impact financial results.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Cyberattacks and security breaches are becoming increasingly sophisticated and could have a significant impact on operations, reputation, and financial performance.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks and Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events (conflicts, trade tensions) and supply chain disruptions may affect the availability of raw materials, transportation costs, and operations across the 30 countries where KMB manufactures.

risks.title: Environmental and Health Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Changes in environmental regulations (plastics, packaging), health standards (hygiene products), and traceability requirements may increase compliance costs and require reinvestment.

risks.title: Reputational Risk and Consumer Perception
risks.score_rationale: Damage to the reputation of premium brands (Huggies, Kleenex, Kotex) due to environmental, health, or ESG controversies could impact consumer trust and market share.

risks.title: Supplier Dependency and Industry Consolidation
risks.score_rationale: High dependency on suppliers of critical raw materials (pulp, absorbent materials). Supplier consolidation reduces alternatives and strengthens counterparty negotiation power.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in Kimberly-Clark's (KMB) 10-K filing. Innovation remains focused on proprietary technologies in absorbent materials and nonwovens.
